fact: On 24 November 2023 the Public Private Partnership Commission said the Government Wide Area Network connectivity initiative, run with the Ministry of Information and Digitalization on World Bank funding, had contracted Bengol.Net, DataCom/Luna Technologies and Inq. Digital to connect over 500 public offices by optic fibre for ten years, with installation complete at more than 300 sites pending certification; it names the Blantyre District Commissioner as an earmarked beneficiary and gives no count of councils.
title: DIGMAP Internet Connectivity to over 500 MDAs
